identity.title: Render callbacks never call the locking internal_diagnostics recorder; heartbeat and frame time only through the wait-free path

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-ARC-028] RENDER CALLBACK REALTIME. [STU-ARC-013] and [HSK-PLG-011] extend to GPU frame and render callbacks: a Studio render callback MUST NOT call the locking `internal_diagnostics` recorder, and heartbeat or frame-time recording from a render callback goes only through the wait-free path. DECLARED GAP, not settled here: the recorder's `record()` takes a mutex and Section 5.8 specifies no preallocated wait-free handoff on it.
